e.title: Napkin AI
e.summary: 文字一键转信息图/示意图（含 MCP 服务）：框架词条与课件的视觉化
e.body: Napkin AI 把一段文字自动转成信息图/示意图（流程图、对比图、时间线），2026 年已提供 MCP 服务（@mindstone-engineering/mcp-server-napkin）供 agent 调用。对本站：[[iso-31000]]、[[coso-erm]]、[[three-lines-of-defense]] 等框架词条的示意图批量生成；与 [[gamma]]（PPT）+ [[heygen]]（视频）组成培训课视觉生产链。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：2026 测评文 + MCP 包确认，未实测
e.summary_en: Turn text into infographics/diagrams in one click (MCP server available): visualize framework entries and courseware
e.summary_hk: 文字一鍵轉信息圖/示意圖（含 MCP 服務）：框架詞條與課件的視覺化
e.body_en: Napkin AI turns a paragraph of text into infographics and diagrams (flowcharts, comparisons, timelines), and since 2026 ships an MCP server (@mindstone-engineering/mcp-server-napkin) for agents. For this site: batch-generate visuals for framework entries such as [[iso-31000]], [[coso-erm]] and [[three-lines-of-defense]]; together with [[gamma]] (slides) and [[heygen]] (video) it completes the training-session visual production chain.
e.body_hk: Napkin AI 把一段文字自動轉成信息圖/示意圖（流程圖、對比圖、時間線），2026 年已提供 MCP 服務（@mindstone-engineering/mcp-server-napkin）供 agent 調用。對本站：[[iso-31000]]、[[coso-erm]]、[[three-lines-of-defense]] 等框架詞條的示意圖批量生成；與 [[gamma]]（PPT）+ [[heygen]]（視頻）組成培訓課視覺生產鏈。
